唐.meaning: Under an old <part>shed</part>, a gardener leans his <part>rake</part> on a <part>pole</part> and digs up <part>one</part> painted vase with a dragon's open <part>mouth</part> on its side. A museum man runs in, shaking: it's a thousand years old, from the great dynasty of the <kanji>T'ang</kanji>.
唐.on: The gardener drops it on his <sound>toe</sound>, but the vase doesn't even crack.
唐.kun: A painted <sound>ca</sound>rp swims round its neck, and the museum man cheers, '<sound>Rah</sound>!'

逐.meaning: A <part>pig</part> escapes the farm and races up a wooden <part>ramp</part> onto the ferry. The farmer chases it, then the dog, then grandma on her scooter. The ferry sails off with all of them aboard, still running laps round the deck. That pig is hard to <kanji>pursue</kanji>.
逐.on: It runs on a bag of <sound>chick</sound>pea crisps it stole from the galley.

恨.meaning: A <part>robot</part> butler dropped the birthday cake thirty years ago, and the whole family laughed. Every time it hears that laugh, its <part>heartbeat</part> monitor spikes. It still polishes the forks, but slowly, wishing it could take that day back. Even metal can carry <kanji>regret</kanji>.
恨.on: It tells its troubles only to a giant <sound>con</sound>dor that perches on the chimney.
恨.kun: It serves the family cold <sound>u</sound>don, and won't join in when they cheer '<sound>Rah</sound>!'

覆.meaning: A racing yacht heading <part>west</part> hits a wave and flips upside down. The crew can't <part>restore</part> it, so they stand on the hull and keep going, steering with an umbrella while fish wave up at them. It's the first race ever won after a <kanji>capsize</kanji>.
覆.on: A crane on the dock lowers a big <sound>hook</sound> and turns the boat right way up.
覆.kun: '<sound>Ohh</sound>,' groan the fish as the sail flops over them like a blanket: to cover.

惜.meaning: A museum cleaner dusts a jar from <part>antiquity</part> that has survived floods, fires and wars. She sneezes. Her <part>heartbeat</part> skips as the jar wobbles, tips and breaks in two. Three thousand years, undone by one sneeze. What a <kanji>pity</kanji>.
惜.on: The guide's pie chart of museum accidents gets a new <sound>sec</sound>tor: sneezes.
惜.kun: '<sound>Oh</sound>,' she whispers, and starts gluing the halves.

陳.meaning: A junk shop faces the <part>east</part>, so at dawn the rising sun lights its window like a stage. Under a faded <part>pennant</part>, the owner sets out his oddest stock: a stuffed walrus in a tutu, a glass eye, a sofa shaped like a shoe. Crowds press their noses to the town's best <kanji>exhibit</kanji>.
陳.on: The walrus has a painted moustache and a very big <sound>chin</sound>.
陳.kun: The owner turns the shoe sofa by its <sound>hee</sound>l, hangs a fishing <sound>ne</sound>t on it and perches a stuffed <sound>roo</sound>k on top: a twist.

兼.meaning: A juggler balances on <part>one</part> leg on top of a <part>pole</part>. On his head sits a helmet with two <part>horns</part>, each spinning a plate; he waves a <part>rake</part> in one hand and kicks <part>eight</part> balls into the air with his free foot, all at once. Every trick happens <kanji>concurrently</kanji>.
兼.on: His dog barks along from its <sound>ken</sound>nel at the foot of the pole.
兼.kun: On the tip of the rake he balances a bowl with a <sound>ca</sound>rp in it.

妨.meaning: A <part>woman</part> paints the sunset from her little boat. Every time she lifts her brush, the <part>sail</part> swings round and blocks the view. She ties it, it flaps loose; she lowers it, the wind lifts it. Not one stroke all evening. Nothing could <kanji>disturb</kanji> her more.
妨.on: Then a <sound>bou</sound>lder rolls off the cliff and splashes her canvas.
妨.kun: A gull drops a <sound>sa</sound>rdine in her <sound>mu</sound>g, then sits in her paint <sound>tu</sound>b.
